newsitem.title: BULGARIA: NO DEALS STRUCK ON BULGARIA EXCHANGE.
newsitem.headline: NO DEALS STRUCK ON BULGARIA EXCHANGE.

text.p: No corporate stocks traded on the Sofia Stock Exchange (SSE) for a sixteenth day in a row and the RABSI (Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index) was unchanged from Friday's 41.31 points, brokers said.
No repo deals in treasury paper were struck on the SSE either. Friday's repo deals turnover amounted to 710,175 levs.
The other local bourse, the Bulgarian Stock Exchange (BSE) has been in a summer recess since August 5 and will resume trading on September 2.
